descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-13 Previous Notes · S14 「第 2 天带一个新肌酐的 Save Note：今天的日期和趋势，昨天的值保留，今天的记录如实交代生命体征和化验」 Day-2 Save Note with one new creatinine: today's date and trend, yesterday's values kept, today's note honest about vitals and labs

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U8 Day-2 Save Note with one new lab (creatinine): the new value shows with today's date and its trend as in the prototype (e.g. 'Cr 1.4, ↑ from 1.1'). Yesterday's value stays with yesterday's date. …（UAT TC-13；UAT 3.7；UAT 3.3；TFA-94699 AC 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U9 Today's note does not present yesterday's vitals or labs as today's. If no vitals were dictated today, the note says so (3.7). …（UAT TC-13；UAT 3.7） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • T2 'Last refreshed' means a new value was recorded. A day-2 Save Note, a Generate, or a prior-note import (old values, Q11) without a new vital, lab or imaging value does not restart that item's 36 h cl …（TFA-94699 AC 2） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress

测试设计方法：边界值（boundary） — 卡在规则的边上（刚好到点 / 过一分钟、空、最长、最多）看行为在哪一边变。

Given S12 chart aged 20 h: Cr 1.1, K 4.2 and BP 128/76 recorded yesterday

When Day 2: type pre-round 'Creatinine 1.4 this morning.' with no vitals and no potassium, press Save Note, then Generate today's note

Then Labs show Cr 1.4 with today's date and '↑ from 1.1' (Q12). Cr 1.1 stays with yesterday's date and K 4.2 keeps yesterday's date. Vitals keep yesterday's date, and this Save Note does not restart their 36 h clock. Today's note does not present BP 128/76 or K 4.2 as today's, and says no vitals were dictated today

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：UAT TC-13 day-2 Save Note bullet + 3.7 + TFA-94699 AC 2/3. Backend read: vitalsUpdatedAt is unchanged by the day-2 Save Note (T2). Judged on the note: no line presents 128/76 or 4.2 as today's, and a no-vitals statement is present. Whether K 4.2 or BP 128/76 may appear with yesterday's date or must be left out is Q14 and is recorded. …
